newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain '97 deficit/GDP target very credible -Ferrer.
newsitem.headline: Spain '97 deficit/GDP target very credible -Ferrer.

text.p: Spain can narrow its deficit to three percent of gross domestic product in 1997, Federico Ferrer, the Treasury's deputy director for foreign financing, told Reuters Financial Television in Tokyo.
"Three percent -- that is an absolutely credible target," Ferrer said. "The reaction of the markets has only shown that this is a credible budget," Ferrer said.
He also said the peseta's current levels were comfortable.
"This middle of the band is 85.00. We are now moving slightly above that level at 84.00," Ferrer said.
"I feel this is a very good level and we feel very comfortable," Ferrer said.
At 1315 GMT, the peseta was trading at 84.05/06 per mark.
